name: Naked and Afraid
description: What happens when you put two complete strangers - sans clothes - in some of the most extreme environments on Earth? Each male-female duo is left with no food, no water, no clothes, and only one survival item each as they attempt to survive on their own.

videos.title: Bares All
videos.overview: Recap, extra footage and commentary with the season 1 cast including their families.

videos.title: Double Jeopardy
videos.overview: Cassie DePecol, Forrest Galante, Manu Toigo and Russell Sage on the Panamanian coast.

videos.title: Bares All 2
videos.overview: Recap, extra footage and commentary with the episode 8 cast, including their families.

videos.title: Bares All: Starvation, Snakes and Strife
videos.overview: Recap, extra footage and commentary with the season 2 survivalists including their families.

videos.title: New Season Exposed
videos.overview: Preview of the new season of Naked and Afraid.

videos.title: Bares All: Blood, Sweat and Fears
videos.overview: Incredible, unseen footage is revealed as nude strangers struggle through fights, pain and tears to survive for 21 days in some of the cruelest environments on the planet. It’s the fights, the pain, and the tears we didn’t see in the original episodes.

videos.title: Snaketacular
videos.overview: From rare snakes to the most venomous serpents on the planet, all the encounters the survivalists have had with snakes are revealed. Then, facts about each snake from all the countries visited on the show are shared.

videos.title: Naked and Awkward
videos.overview: Exclusive, never-before-seen footage reveals the good, the bad, the awkward and the downright weirdest moments from their adventures.

videos.title: Bares All: Survival in Close Quarters
videos.overview: Footage of the survivalists reveals good, bad, awkward and weird moments from their various adventures.

videos.title: Easier Said than Done
videos.overview: In this special episode, two fans of the show, Kristin Young and Brian Rivers, winners of the #ShowUsWhatYouGot "Naked and Afraid" contest, strip down and try to survive the jungle of Nicaragua for 14 days.

videos.title: Bares All: On The Edge
videos.overview: Survivalists and fans reveal their perspective on a challenge, including unaired footage and interviews.

videos.title: Into the Wild
videos.overview: Twelve pairs of survivalists compete over six continents in this first-look at Season 6.

videos.title: Bares All: Never Give Up
videos.overview: Recap, extra footage and commentary with the season 6 survivalists including their families.

videos.title: Bares All: Battered and Broken
videos.overview: Recap, extra footage and commentary with the season 6 survivalists including their families.

videos.title: Bares All: Naked Nights
videos.overview: Surviving in the wilderness for 21 days stripped of clothes, food and water is the ultimate test of survival. Daytime presents its own dangers, but come night fall the survivalists are faced with a whole new set of threats.

videos.title: The Lost World
videos.overview: Two fans of the show are selected for a special 14-day survival challenge. Single mom Gabrielle Balassone and optimist Jonathan Short try to survive the Wild Coast of South Africa.

videos.title: Suffering, Sunburn And Sharks
videos.overview: We discover the grueling locations the survivalists will encounter and what some of their most dangerous threats and challenges will be, getting up close and personal with six pairs of new survivalists.

videos.title: Belize Breakdown
videos.overview: On this fan episode of Naked and Afraid, pro surfer Anastasia Ashley and YouTuber Cory Williams take their shot at surviving Naked and Afraid. Do they have what it takes to survive 14 days completely unplugged from civilization in the jungles of Belize?

videos.title: Unsurvivable
videos.overview: Mother Nature is full throttle this season as 20 new survivalists attempt the 21-day challenge. Hurricanes, broken bones, unrelenting insects, bear encounters, deadly snakes and wasp stings on the worst of places... just a usual day for Naked and Afraid.

videos.title: Island of Tears
videos.overview: Max Djenohan and Bianca Isidro face off with aggressive caiman, boa constrictors, large spiders and thorny mangroves in this Superfan 14-day challenge on a tropical island in Panama.

videos.title: Fan Down
videos.overview: After being chosen in the #ShowUsWhatYouGot Naked And Afraid contest, fan favorites Maci Bookout and Justin Tuell get ready to strip down and start their special 14 day challenge in the treacherous Nicaraguan jungle.

videos.title: Naked And Afraid Of Sharks
videos.overview: Discovery Channel brought together Naked and Afraid and Shark Week in the form of the two-hour special. Former N&A participants Ky Furneaux, Ryan Holt, Chris Fischer, Steven Lee Hall and Eva Rupert are stranded on an island in the middle of the most shark-infested waters in the world for 14 days (Bahamas).

videos.title: Eaten Alive
videos.overview: Spiders, botflies, mosquitoes and other torturous bugs and insects are always the unexpected threat that take down survivalists on Naked and Afraid.

videos.title: Naked Gets Weird
videos.overview: Surviving 21 days Naked in the wilderness leads to weird and awkward moments. From bizarre pre-challenge prep and mortifying naked intros, to night-time cuddling gone wrong and learning wildlife bathroom routines the hard way, Naked and Afraid gets weird

videos.title: Bootcamp
videos.overview: Two Naked and Afraid super-fans get special training with N&A veteran Gabrielle Balassone before setting off for a 21-day challenge with all-stars Matt Wright and Gary Golding.

videos.title: Jungle Genius
videos.overview: Give a man a fish and you feed him for a day; Teach a man to fish and you feed him for a lifetime. From shelters, Traps and rafts to wilderness fashion take a look at the survivalist's most successful, Yet wacky, Primitive design and techniques.

videos.title: Watch Party: Andrea and Joe in Namibia
videos.overview: Andrea Lopez and Joe Brandl get together virtually to catch up with each other and watch their challenge in Namibia. They offer fresh perspective and new insights into their struggles, partner dynamics, and survival tactics.

videos.title: Watch Party: Dani And Justin In Andros Islands
videos.overview: Dani Julien and Justin Bullard get together virtually to catch up with each other and watch their challenge in Andros Islands. They offer fresh perspective and new insights into their struggles, partner dynamics, and survival tactics.

videos.title: Watch Party: Bulent and Cat in Colombian Rainforest
videos.overview: Bulent Gurcan and Cat Orza get together virtually to catch up with each other and watch their challenge in the Colombian rainforest. They offer fresh perspective and new insights into their struggles, partner dynamics and survival tactics.

videos.title: Watch Party: Trish and Jeremy
videos.overview: Survivalists Trish Bulinsky and Jeremy Upshaw re-connect to catch up with each other and watch their challenge in the Colombian jungle. They offer fresh perspective and new insights as they fight torrential rains, swarming insects and flash floods.

videos.title: The Jungle Curse
videos.overview: Shane Lewis and Kim Shelton have to survive 21 days in the Costa Rican jungle, where a producer has survived a venomous snake bite.

videos.title: Terror in Tanzania
videos.overview: Survivalists EJ Snyder and Kellie Nightlinger survive in Tanzania's Serengeti Plain, putting their skills to the ultimate test.

videos.title: Island From Hell
videos.overview: Jonathan Klay and Alison Teal are marooned in the Maldives for 21 days and clash with sunburn and starvation.

videos.title: Punishment in Panama
videos.overview: Clint Jivoin and Laura Zerra have to stay 21 days on a Panamanian island, plagued with sand flies and threatened by snakes.

videos.title: Breaking Borneo
videos.overview: Survivalists Puma Cabra and Julie Wright have to survive 21 days in Borneo. They battle with sickness, starvation, and wildlife.

videos.title: Beware the Bayou
videos.overview: Billy Berger and Ky Furneaux survive 21 days in the swamps of Louisiana. They risk attack from deadly snakes and alligators.

videos.title: Double Jeopardy
videos.overview: Two pairs of strangers, dropped on opposite ends of the remote Panamanian rainforest, eventually meet and must work together to conquer the Everest of extreme survival challenges.

videos.title: Man Vs. Amazon
videos.overview: Amanda "AK" Kaye and Tyler Steinle failed to survive in the Amazon rainforest after tapping out, season 1 castaways EJ Snyder and Laura Zerra arrive to complete AK and Tyler's 21 day journey.

videos.title: Damned in Africa
videos.overview: Jeff Zausch and Eva Rupert test their survival skills in the harsh desert of Madagascar's Massif D'Isalo. Their camp was badly burned when they attempted to cook snake meat and they barely survived.

videos.title: Paradise Lost
videos.overview: Alana Barfield and Keith Busch have a deserted island in Fiji all to themselves. Keith left early on day 11 for seizures; Alana survives alone for full 21 days.

videos.title: Mayan Misery
videos.overview: Shannon Thomas and Leonard "Cass" Cassidy are challenged to survive in a flooded jungle of Belize.

videos.title: The Pain Forest
videos.overview: Firefighter Fernando Calderon and single mom Samantha Pearson endure relentless storms in a Malaysia rain forest.

videos.title: Meltdown in Bolivia
videos.overview: Vincent Pinto and Sabrina Mergenthaler face flash floods and heat exhaustion in a Bolivia jungle. Vincent suffered from stomach ache on day 16, and Sabrina suffered severe abdominal pain on day 20, one day short to end the 21 day challenge.

videos.title: Primal Fear
videos.overview: Lindsey Leitelt and Luke McLaughlin challenged in a dense harsh land in Namibia.

videos.title: Blood in the Water
videos.overview: Dani Julien and Justin Bullard stranded with starvation and tiny predators in the Bahamas' Andros islands.

videos.title: Hearts of Darkness
videos.overview: Carrie Booze and Tom Touw survive with crocodiles and extreme heat in Cambodia.

videos.title: Jungle Love
videos.overview: Jaclyn McCaffrey and Adam Young survive in Nicaragua for battling with dehydration and freezing temperatures.

videos.title: Argentina Impossible
videos.overview: Survival coach Tom McElroy and pediatrician Lisa Coray fight with storms and dehydration in Argentina's Yungas forest.

videos.title: Playing With Fire
videos.overview: Corinne Kohlen and Chris Fischer are stranded on a deserted beach in Dominica. Corinne tapped out on day 13, and Chris left alone for full 21 days.

videos.title: Himalayan Hell
videos.overview: Hakim Isler and Phaedra Brothers tackle the high altitude and extreme cold of the Himalayan foothills in northern India. Phaedra battles food poisoning from before her arrival and suffers through bladder and kidney infections.

videos.title: Nicaragua Nightmare
videos.overview: Joshua Bell and Amanda Leigh face the hot and swampy jungles of southern Nicaragua while armed with only a machete and a roll of duct tape. Joshua leaves early on day 5 for dehydration and Amanda survives all alone for the rest of the 21 days.

videos.title: Botswana Breakdown
videos.overview: Ashley Burns and Michael Jefferson attempt to survive dazzling heat in Botswana. Ashley medically evacuated on day 3 after suffering dizziness, while Michael tapped out on day 12 after hurting his kidney.

videos.title: Dunes of Despair
videos.overview: Honora Bowen and Matt Strutzel survive hunger and dehydration in Brazil's North Region. Despite Honora passed out from severe heat, Matt completes the challenge all alone.

videos.title: Alligator Alley
videos.overview: An Army mom and a U.S. marine battle alligators, snakes and mosquitoes in the Florida Everglades.

videos.title: Rumble in the Jungle
videos.overview: Christina and Steve take on the Mexican jungles of Quintana Roo for 21 days.

videos.title: Mayan Sacrifice
videos.overview: Luke, a go-getter from Southern California, and Alyssa, a positive survival instructor, take on the rugged coast of the Yucatan.

videos.title: Edge of Madness
videos.overview: Two survivalists take on the hot and hellish conditions of Guyana’s equatorial savannah.

videos.title: Fire on the Mountain
videos.overview: Avid outdoorsman Trenton and novice survivalist Jen take on high elevation in the peaks of Udhampur, India.

videos.title: Lord of the Rats
videos.overview: A workaholic mom and a loner are challenged to survive three weeks in Thailand.

videos.title: Colombian Conflict
videos.overview: Charlie, a no-nonsense New Yorker, and Danielle, a nature-loving vegetarian, attempt to survive for 21 days in the deadly Colombian jungle.

videos.title: Garden of Evil
videos.overview: A Navy veteran and a military mother survive on an island in Mexico where they encounter a panther and attempt to avoid poisonous tree sap.

videos.title: Redemption Road
videos.overview: A past contestant returns to the show and along with her partner attempts to survive the jungles of Guyana.

videos.title: Surthrive
videos.overview: An independent mother and a Green Beret battle sand flies, venomous snakes and an infestation of caiman in Guyana.

videos.title: Easier Said Than Done
videos.overview: Two fans are selected for a two-week long challenge in Nicaragua.

videos.title: Forsaken
videos.overview: When sparks don't fly deep in Panama's Isla San José, an ex-cop Gary Underhill and a "wild child" Kim Kelly clash over cuddling.

videos.title: Fear The Unknown
videos.overview: Trent Nielsen and Annie Foley are afraid of the dark in the mysterious Mayan jungles of Belize.

videos.title: The Darkest Hour
videos.overview: Mountaineer Joe Brandl and former cop Andrea Lopez survive in Namibia, which is home to dangerous predators, but inner demons seem to cause more trouble.

videos.title: The Swarm
videos.overview: Tara Skubella and Dustin Hobbs must endure the jungles of Panama's Isla San José, where disease-carrying insects may prove to be the team's greatest threat.

videos.title: All or Nothing
videos.overview: Hunter Jeremy McCaa and surfer girl Cassidy Flynn must survive on West Nalaut Island in the Philippines.

videos.title: King of the Forest
videos.overview: A self-proclaimed 'king of the forest' and an endurance athlete tackle the backwoods of Alabama. They secure shelter and a fire early on, but when hunger kicks in, one of them does something that's never been seen in show history.

videos.title: Frozen in Fear
videos.overview: A marine biologist and a special forces veteran risk hypothermia at every turn as they take on Ontario, Canada, with no clothes. Bitter cold, torrential rain and wandering bears and moose make every night a struggle.

videos.title: Rise Above
videos.overview: A horse trainer and a wilderness instructor take on the rain-soaked jungle of Colombia's Amazonia. Constant downpours and a lack of resources make one survivalist hit rock bottom, and the other is forced to pick up the slack.

videos.title: From the Ashes
videos.overview: Two survivalists team up to tackle the swampy shore of Croatia. A strong partnership is forged through braving the elements and facing their demons, but everything takes a turn for the worst after a freak accident.

videos.title: All Falls Down
videos.overview: An elite endurance athlete and a stay-at-home dad team up to take on the rugged Belize jungle. Jaguars, venomous snakes, falling trees and powerful storms threaten their evolving partnership.

videos.title: Contamination
videos.overview: A stay-at-home mom and a trucker try to survive in a Philippine forest after a typhoon scatters debris everywhere. Combating sickness and no food, they come together and ward off hunger by eating a skunk.

videos.title: Hell or High Water
videos.overview: A special ops veteran teams up with a single mom to fight torrential rains, flash floods and sickness in Thailand's Sai Rung River Valley. The pair puts their skills to the test before the river leaves them stranded from the crew.

videos.title: The Danger Within
videos.overview: A resilient mom from Washington and a quirky spider-lover tackle the remote Seminole Forest of Florida. Terrorized by huge gators and 550-pound black bears, they are driven to their physical and emotional breaking points.

videos.title: Melt Down Under
videos.overview: An adventure guide and a veteran take on Australia's Outback and face brutal terrain, freezing temperatures and lack of sleep. However, their greatest danger may be each other when cultural differences cause tempers to flare.

videos.title: Bad Blood
videos.overview: Survivalists take on the arid lakebeds of Nicaragua. The cutthroat environment features venomous snakes and deadly caiman, but when one of them fails to pull their weight, it becomes clear their worst enemy could be each other.

videos.title: Strength in Pain
videos.overview: Two survivalists battle the Honduran rain forest. They survive punishing storms, frigid nights and a nasty case of Montezuma's revenge, but a terrifying encounter with a deadly snake brings the pair to their breaking point.

videos.title: 23 Days
videos.overview: An inexperienced survivalist and a wilderness enthusiast take on the unforgiving savanna of Namibia. The harsh conditions quickly take a toll, and the challenge is further complicated when a competitor returns for redemption.

videos.title: Eye Of The Storm
videos.overview: Two survivalists take on the Belize Jungle to survive for 21 days with no food, water or clothes. They must put their skills to the ultimate test to overcome a catastrophic hurricane and predator-filled environment.

videos.title: Washed Out
videos.overview: An extreme athlete and a book smart bartender tackle an Ecuadorian cloud forest where it rains daily. Will their inability to know their own limits eventually get the best of them or will Mother Nature strike the final blow in this Naked and Afraid first?

videos.title: Hangry
videos.overview: Former Marine Tim, and Shannon, a stonemason take on armies of stinging red ants and bubbling mud volcanoes on the Caribbean island of Trinidad. Even with this daunting location working against them, their biggest struggle is actually each other.

videos.title: Ashes to Ashes
videos.overview: A survival instructor and a retiree of the armed forces are inserted into the volcano-ravaged island of Montserrat; they have different survival styles but find a way to work together, then one accident has an eruptive effect on both.

videos.title: The Lost World
videos.overview: Two fans, a single mom and an optimistic novice, are selected to take on a special fourteen-day survival challenge on the coast of South Africa.

videos.title: The Monster
videos.overview: A California Buddhist and an Oregon fisherman test their skills against the unforgiving Australian outback, where harsh conditions, scarce food sources and saltwater crocodiles threaten their survival.

videos.title: Unhinged
videos.overview: An ex-marine and a perky Southern girl face constant downpours, cabin fever, threats from predators, lack of sleep and extreme hunger in the Panamanian Jungle.

videos.title: Curse of the Swamp
videos.overview: A survivalist and an Air Force veteran try to survive in the swamps of Louisiana, but there is trouble in the partnership.

videos.title: Curse of the Swamp: Part 2
videos.overview: Jeremy and Melanie continue their challenge in the haunted swamps of Louisiana, enduring threats from predators as they search for food.

videos.title: Arachnid Overload
videos.overview: A survival-savvy yoga teacher and a custom knife maker tackle the brutal jungle of Colombia. Their primitive survival skills are impressive, but the deadly spiders and tics test both their courage and resilience, threatening to take them down.

videos.title: Worlds Collide
videos.overview: A former military man and an optimistic naturalist face humidity, violent storms, caiman, and red-bellied piranha in the Amazon jungle.

videos.title: Lost at Sea
videos.overview: Two survivalists are stranded at sea and have to survive for 21 days with no food, water or clothes. They must put their skills to the test to overcome deadly sharks and heatstroke that threaten their survival.

videos.title: Texan Torture
videos.overview: A surfer from Hawaii and an ex-military take on the Texas countryside, surrounded by armadillo, bighorn sheep and vicious wild boar; as they battle starvation and face a potentially fatal flood, their skills get fully put to the test.

videos.title: The Hunted
videos.overview: A mother of four and a country boy are dropped into the jaguar filled jungle of Belize. While they hunt for food, something is hunting them, and the mental part of the challenge gets to them both. Can they survive the jungle and themselves?

videos.title: Rain of Terror
videos.overview: A mom and an adventure addict drop into the cloud forest of Ecuador; unbearably wet conditions, violent lightning, cabin fever, trench foot and finger-slicing machetes threaten to keep the pair from completing their 21-day challenge.

videos.title: Stone Cold
videos.overview: An Army vet and a newly married man grapple with gender norms as they take on the mountains of Croatia; extreme hunger and frigid temperatures force this unlikely pair to bond together, but a vicious storm threatens to rip them apart.

videos.title: Belize Breakdown
videos.overview: On this fan episode of Naked and Afraid, pro surfer Anastasia Ashley, and YouTuber Cory Williams take their shot at surviving Naked and Afraid. Do they have what it takes to survive completely unplugged from civilization in the jungles of Belize?

videos.title: Category 5 Survival
videos.overview: A category five Hurricane blasts through the camp of Amal, an Iraqi war refugee now living in Iowa and her partner, Duke. In addition to the hurricane, the pair also endure venomous spiders, insects, and nocturnal predators in the swamps of Florida.

videos.title: A Screw Loose
videos.overview: In a haunted Mayan jungle, a painful injury tests the resolve of survivalists Leah and Caesar. Surviving is a struggle as they are faced with suffocating humidity, hungry predators, torrential rainfall, unrelenting insects and intoxicating fruit.

videos.title: Swamp Queen
videos.overview: In the snake-filled Mississippi swamps, Gabrielle, a former fan survivalist takes on the full 21-day challenge. Gabrielle and Brian are faced with deadly snakes, unrelenting mosquitos, nocturnal predators and a relentless week-long thunderstorm.

videos.title: Forbidden Fruit
videos.overview: Terribly poisoned without food or water, in the arid and desolate, savannah region of Brazil, survivalists Gary and Karra will be tested unlike any other survivalists before them. Depleted and broken will either of them make it to Day 21?

videos.title: Island of Tears
videos.overview: Max and Bianca face off with aggressive caiman, boa constrictors, large spiders, and thorny mangroves in this Superfan challenge on a tropical island in Panama.

videos.title: Thieves in the Night
videos.overview: One survivalist falls into a roaring fire after weeks of depleted energy due to no food. With just days to go, the pair makes a daring plan for how to survive...but will it cost them the challenge?

videos.title: Love At First Fight
videos.overview: Instant attraction gives way to unforgiving conditions on a Nicaraguan island teeming with bull sharks and big cats.  As the struggle to survive hits a low point  a brutal flood threatens to wipe out the camp and all chances of survival.

videos.title: Burnt To A Crisp
videos.overview: Tormented by hostile crocodiles, territorial howler monkeys and no tree canopy to protect them from the sun in this post-hurricane Nicaraguan jungle, one survivalist suffers third-degree sunburn while the other's life is threatened by a mysterious illness

videos.title: Loaded for Bear
videos.overview: Surrounded by aggressive and territorial black bears day and night, two survivalists must compete against the apex predators for resources in the Smoky Mountains of Tennessee.

videos.title: Pick Your Poison
videos.overview: Swarming wasps, deadly anacondas, poisonous toads and venomous stingrays surround the survivalists in sun-scorched Brazil. Just days into their challenge, a standoff with a poisonous Fer-de-lance snake threatens to send both survivalists home.

videos.title: Trouble in Paradise
videos.overview: Torrential downpours and brutal wind storms push two starving survivalists to their breaking points in the Honduran jungle.

videos.title: Fan Down
videos.overview: A freak injury puts super-fan survivalists Maci and Justin at risk as they attempt to survive the treacherous Nicaraguan jungle for 14 days.

videos.title: Blindsided
videos.overview: A dangerous burn and clashing survival strategies plague survivalists Angela and Steven in the jungles of Panama.

videos.title: Fire and Fury
videos.overview: Stalked by aggressive leopards and unable to get fire for protection, two survivalists fight the elements and each other as they look for double redemption on a predator-filled plain in South Africa.

videos.title: Frozen and Afraid
videos.overview: Dropped onto a frozen Alaskan Glacier, All-Star survivalists Laura Zerra and Steven Hall scramble to stave off frostbite and hypothermia. And 7,000 miles south, two new survivalists take on a sun-scorched Brazil island, with anaconda and deadly stingray.

videos.title: You've Got Another Sting Coming
videos.overview: On a sun-scorched Brazilian island, aggressive anaconda and deadly stingray torment survivalists Whitney and Nathan, pushing both of them to their breaking point. Working together they use their hunting and fishing skills to try and make it 21 days.

videos.title: No Safety In Numbers
videos.overview: Two pairs of survivalists are surprised when they must take on the deadly jungles of Panama side-by-side. But before their 21-day challenge begins, they have to re-think their survival strategies along gender lines.

videos.title: Threesome
videos.overview: When a third survivalist crashes the challenge, tension and jealousy are just as threatening as the piranha and jaguars of the Ecuadorian rainforest. Claims that there's more going on than just survival puts everyone's challenge at risk.

videos.title: Baked Alaskan
videos.overview: A deadly spider bite puts Gwen, an Alaskan homesteader at risk of tapping but she works with her partner to get her revenge, in the 130-degree heat of the Mexican jungle.

videos.title: Stomping Grounds
videos.overview: Elite survivalists Matt Wright and Gary Golding are tested by deadly spitting cobras and territorial elephants in an African killing zone. But Matt and Gary aren't alone each must protect a novice survivalist from the threats surrounding them.

videos.title: Bite Club
videos.overview: A survivor of rattlesnake, shark and bear attacks teams with Brooke, wife of "Naked and Afraid" veteran Matt Wright, in a vicious African feeding ground.

videos.title: The Spirits Are Angry
videos.overview: A haunted Colombian rain forest punishes the survivalists with threats from deadly jaguars, 300 species of snakes and relentless biting insects. But their challenge is threatened when they don't heed the curse of the jungle.

videos.title: Naked and Haunted
videos.overview: Survivalists expect to struggle against the natural threats for 21 days but when they also face supernatural phenomena – haunted locations, ancient curses and evil spirits – their resolve is tested both physically and mentally.

videos.title: Stalked on All Sides
videos.overview: Pinned down by Africa's most dangerous threats elephants, hippos and lions, survivalists "Mama Kel" and Eric work together to avoid becoming prey and endure relentless storms, but a debilitating injury puts them both at risk.

videos.title: Swamp Don't Care
videos.overview: All-Star survivalists Jake Nodar and Melissa Miller take on the punishing Blackwater Swamp in Florida, which teems with poisonous snakes and aggressive alligators. When one of the survivalists becomes disorientated, local authorities are called in to conduct an all-out search.

videos.title: What the Duck
videos.overview: Two fan survivalists are dropped on a Mexican island filled with venomous coral snakes, territorial jaguars, blood-sucking chiquistas and a duck named Henry that they desperately want to eat for dinner.

videos.title: For Better Or A lot Worse
videos.overview: The first couple to ever take on the 21-day challenge tests themselves and their relationship as they take on the Guyana jungle. They must work together to battle jaguars, anacondas, caiman, and more than two-million species of insects.

videos.title: Don't Let the Jungle Bugs Bite
videos.overview: Avoiding the dangers of a rushing river, two survivalists brave a vast cave system in the Colombian rainforest; trying to survive 21 days, the jungle tests them with threats including venomous fer-de-lance snakes, piranhas and biting insects.

videos.title: Meltdown on the Mountain
videos.overview: Dropped into a high-altitude jungle in Colombia, Tommy and Leah face territorial Pumas and venomous fer-de-lance snakes, but the biggest threat is the extreme temperature changes, where highs hit nearly 100 degrees and lows plummet into the 40s.

videos.title: Just Kidding
videos.overview: Being naked in the jungle with a complete stranger can lead to funny moments, and laughter can be a critical skill when trying to survive through blood, sweat, tears, snake bites, burns, and rashes in hard to reach places.

videos.title: Honduran Hell
videos.overview: In the mountainous rainforest of Honduras, a survivalist with an unusual past is paired with a hard-headed police detective to try and survive 21 days, but predatory jaguars, swarms of fire ants and a debilitating injury threaten their challenge.

videos.title: Stalked on the Savannah (Part 1)
videos.overview: In sun-scorched Brazil, survivalists Wes and Jesse try to complete their 21-day challenge, but a jaguar crossing into their camp puts them on high alert. Starvation forces Jesse to attack a beehive in search of honey and the entire colony retaliates.

videos.title: Stalked On The Savannah (Part 2)
videos.overview: In sun-scorched Brazil, survivalists Wes and Jesse try to complete their 21-day challenge, but a jaguar crossing into their camp puts them on high alert. Starvation forces Jesse to attack a beehive in search of honey and the entire colony retaliates.

videos.title: Feel The Burn
videos.overview: Dropped into Guyana's scorching savannah, two Naked and Afraid superfans fight the oppressive heat and constant insect attacks. Scorching temperatures lead to severe dehydration and force a desperate fan to risk illness by drinking unsanitary fluids.

videos.title: Twinning
videos.overview: In an unprecedented Naked and Afraid challenge, identical twin sisters Amber and Serena, as well as brothers Warren and Thomas, are dropped in the African savannah. They take on rhinos, hyenas and a territorial leopard stalking their camp.

videos.title: Little Person, Big Challenge
videos.overview: Underestimated his whole life, a survivalist with dwarfism tries to prove himself in the Amazon but struggles against predators and his partner.

videos.title: Bahama Drama
videos.overview: In the Bahamas two fans face relentless insects and aggressive sharks during hurricane season.

videos.title: Two Tarzans, One Jane
videos.overview: When a third survivalist is added to the mix, romantic complications make surviving the Colombian jungle's poisonous dart frogs and deadly jaguars much more complicated. Feeling left out, a survivalist's emotional breakdown puts his challenge at risk

videos.title: Naked and Ghosted
videos.overview: In a brutal Mexican jungle known to be haunted by Mayan spirits, All-star survivalists Sarah and Trent are tormented by rain, predators and spirits of the rainforest.

videos.title: Close Encounters
videos.overview: Two strangers are dropped in one of the most dangerous African locations in the dead heat of Summer. Faced with aggressive hippos and charging elephants they quickly learn their place, but must mark their territory if they want to make it 21 Days.

videos.title: In Too Deep
videos.overview: On the edge of the Bermuda Triangle, an Army veteran dive master and a Cajun boat captain take on relentless thunderstorms and battle dehydration as they try navigate more than 20 miles of open ocean in the ultimate test of sink or swim.

videos.title: Blood, Sweat And Fears
